Our studio repairs bicycles brought in from across the valley, and every frame gets a full inspection.

Wheels are trued by hand, cables replaced when frayed, and brakes adjusted until they stop cleanly.

Most repairs are ready in two days; larger rebuilds take a week while parts arrive from the supplier.

EVERY REPAIR INCLUDES A FREE SAFETY CHECK THIS MONTH at both locations.
